questions.title: Two Sum Target Matcher
questions.prompt: Implement solution(numsStr, target) in JavaScript. numsStr is a comma-separated string of integers. Return two different zero-based indices as a string 'i,j' whose values sum to target. Scan the second index j from left to right and return the first matching pair; for repeated values, use the most recent earlier index. Return an empty string if no pair exists. Example: solution('2,7,11,15', 9) returns '0,1'. Test inputs use JSON argument arrays, for example ["2,7,11,15",9]. Constraints: 1 to 100 integers, each between -1000 and 1000; target is an integer between -2000 and 2000. Input is valid; no empty fields. Return a string. Scoring: each criterion earns its weight only when every associated test passes. If any essential criterion fails, this question is capped at 15/50. These draft rules await human review and pilot.
questions.solutionCode: function solution(numsStr, target) { const nums = String(numsStr).split(',').map(Number); const seen = new Map(); for (let j = 0; j < nums.length; j++) { const other = Number(target) - nums[j]; if (seen.has(other)) return seen.get(other) + ',' + j; seen.set(nums[j], j); } return ''; }

rubric.scoring: All cases within a criterion must pass to earn its weight; essential failure caps question at 30% (15/50). Draft, uncalibrated.

questions.title: Valid Palindrome Verifier
questions.prompt: Implement solution(str) in JavaScript. Keep only ASCII letters A-Z/a-z and digits 0-9, ignore letter case, and return boolean true if the remaining string reads identically forward and backward; otherwise return false. An empty normalized string is a palindrome. Example: solution('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama') returns true. Test inputs use JSON argument arrays, preserving commas and whitespace inside strings. Input length is 0 to 1000 UTF-16 code units. Remove non-ASCII characters BEFORE converting ASCII letters to lowercase. Return a boolean, not a string. Scoring: each criterion earns its weight only when every associated test passes. If any essential criterion fails, this question is capped at 15/50. These draft rules await human review and pilot.
questions.solutionCode: function solution(str) { const clean = String(str).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '').toLowerCase(); return clean === clean.split('').reverse().join(''); }

rubric.scoring: All cases within a criterion must pass to earn its weight; essential failure caps question at 30% (15/50). Draft, uncalibrated.

criteria.label: ASCII-only filtering before lowercase; keep digits
True and false symmetry decisions including empty strings
